title: Which Google Cloud data store does the question want?

questions.ask: Analysts, ad hoc SQL over years of history, dashboards, no servers?
Relational, with writes that must scale out or stay strongly consistent across regions?
PostgreSQL, high performance, reports on live transactional data?
Existing MySQL, PostgreSQL or SQL Server app, minimal change, one region?
Very large single-keyed data: time series, IoT, lookups by device and time?
Mobile or web app, flexible documents, real-time sync, offline?

otherwise: Sub-millisecond reads of data that can be rebuilt: Memorystore in front of a database
caption: Read the stem from the top: the first question answered yes names the store.
